preprocessing: Numerical median imputation + StandardScaler; categorical most-frequent imputation + OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore').

browser_derived_features.CabinDeck: First segment of Cabin split on '/'.
browser_derived_features.CabinNumber: Numeric second segment of Cabin split on '/'; missing/malformed becomes missing.
browser_derived_features.CabinSide: Third segment of Cabin split on '/'.
browser_derived_features.TotalSpending: Sum of RoomService, FoodCourt, ShoppingMall, Spa, and VRDeck when at least one is supplied.
browser_derived_features.HasSpending: String boolean of TotalSpending > 0; missing when TotalSpending is missing.
browser_derived_features.GroupSize: Explicit browser field. PassengerId is intentionally not collected, so group membership cannot be inferred client-side.

browser_inference.conversion_note: ONNX contains the fitted ColumnTransformer and GradientBoostingClassifier. The Python-only TitanicFeatureEngineer is represented by the documented browser input contract.
